layout_budget.default_constructor: TrainingMoE passes num_bytes=None; ElasticBuffer.get_buffer_size_hint uses experts1024,rows=gather_rows=min(world,4)*B*K=262144, then2 equal page-aligned halves. This is conservative configured capacity, not observed actual rows/gather stride.
layout_budget.actual_required_observation: Record actual allocated runtime.capacity and handle.address_stride/_gather_stride, native layout offsets and counts without new device synchronization before admitting capacity claims. Actual balanced rows65536 known from deterministic routing; gather stride not guessed. Python mirrors alone do not establish native allocation/UDMA qualification.
layout_budget.default_capacity_not_general_skew: World*B*K theoretical max1048576; all-to-firstK skew would put524288 rows on rank0/1, beyond the4BK262144 hint. It is outside this balanced contract.

memory.reference_cap_boundary: 12GiB bounds only frozen additive reference reservation (routed5.9033203125GiB/shared BF16 8.3564453125GiB). It excludes native symmetric heap/HCCL/framework, routed saved state/temp and allocator overhead; do not equate it to total-device peak or raise cap.
memory.overestimation: Sums across forward/backward and transient stages that are not simultaneously live; intentionally conservative for listed components. Some source/weight/grad components are also counted by reference reservation, so adding them double-counts safely.
memory.repeated_step_reason: engine.last_grads_fp32 retains previous FP32 dW until new dW1+dW2 complete and tuple overwritten. clear_grads frees leaf grads, not this engine attribute. Fresh one-step qualification lacks this persistent-step peak.
memory.BF16_vs_FP32_master_boundary: BF16 primary plan: parameters2B/param; FP32 wgrad separately retained and BF16 leaf cast. FP32 optional mode needs independent identity/capacity proof: leaf is master4B, BF16 compute casts2B; conservatively reserve leaf/current gradients separately unless actual alias measured. No Adam or invented second master copy.
still_unbounded_here: HCCL/native runtime side allocations and actual SHMEM heap overhead beyond exposedcapacity
Torch/framework state, allocator fragmentation/reserved pools, nativepersistent route metadata/tensor-min2MiB allocations
Profiler buffers and hardware diagnostic overhead
Autograd gradient accumulation/casts/merge aliases are conservatively accounted only as listed; actual peak must be measured outside timing with matching memory state.
memory.claim: This is a component-wise arithmetic upper reservation, not a proved global NPU memory upper bound. Missing native/allocator allocations prevent an unconditional fit claim.

immutable_cost_boundaries: Xe/GU/A/Z remain savedBF16; original BF16rounded unweighted Z is necessary for exact current dp includingp0. No division byp and no dA-dot-A fast replacement.
P1 gating/activation remain native pointwise kernels. Their time, buffer writes and source row/expert row conversion are included; do not charge only GEMMs.

recompute=false fixed in schema2. A future only-Xe strict recompute must reproduce BF16 GU/A/Z and adds both GMM1+GMM2; it is a new configuration/qualification and not an uncharged memory optimization.
Forward fresh Notify + dispatch; backward cached dY dispatch; dXe/dp combine all included. No cache-plan cost removal hidden in serial/overlap control.
Shared is unweighted independent expert atB8192, adds sharedY/shared dx merge and full shared weight grads; exact same add path in serial/overlap. No shared optimizer or independent SHMEM owner.

original_timing_boundary.permission: No new timing/profiler functionality or device command created. Only after each exact target schedule/shared configuration independently qualified and parent separately approves a matching harness.
original_timing_boundary.step: clear_grads(x,w1,w2,p,optionalshared) then engine(...).backward(dy), grad enabled, same inputs/dY each iteration. No reference recompute/check/statistics inside measured step; no optimizer.
original_timing_boundary.setup_excluded: Engine/session/create/destroy, fixed input creation, reference validation, initial/final provenance, explicit alignment barrier and event construction excluded; their real failure/release audit remains required outside timing.
original_timing_boundary.event_scope: Original timing_round_robin current-compute-stream events start/end around full step. Final combinewait makes return dependency visible; interval includes stream idle/waits and is not pure kernels/communication time.
original_timing_boundary.wall_scope: Original synchronized Python step includes gradient reset, all forward/backward dispatch/Notify/GEMM/pointwise/gate/combine, actual host preflight/launch, output creation/casts and final sync; start/end event record API overhead included, event object construction/barrier excluded.
original_timing_boundary.comparison: One engine/owner per process, separate serial and overlap processes with same-order math. Only after qualifiers, use matched separate-process order control; no twoSHMEMowners. Capture everyrank event+wall per iteration and maxrank per iteration. Profile separate2-3step phase, raw hardware timestamps; two stream submissions not physical-overlap proof.
original_timing_boundary.no_claims: FLOPs only GEMMs2perMAC; no peakMFU/HFU/bandwidth or speedup estimate. No inferenceforward vs trainingfull comparison.
